title: 2-Week Trapping Intensive
description: Focused intermediate program dedicated to mastering Chi Sao and trapping range techniques. Develops sensitivity, timing, and close-range control.

days.notes: Foundation day. Master the 9 basic entries before advancing. Focus on structure and angles.
Transition from trapping to striking. Flow seamlessly between ranges.
Defensive trapping. Trap the attack, then counter. Timing is everything.
Rest and practice sensitivity drills mentally. Visualize feeling your opponent's energy.
Longer combinations from trapping range. Maintain contact while striking.
Counter hooks using trapping. Control the elbow, control the punch.
Week 1 review. Practice all trapping entries, then drill all punches. Integration tomorrow.
Midpoint rest. Your sensitivity should be improving. Week 2 adds complexity.
Extended trapping sequences. Stay sticky, feel the gaps, exploit the openings.
Advanced integration. From trapping directly into JFK combinations.
Trapping to kicking. Control arms, attack legs. Unexpected combinations.
Maximum complexity. Long combinations maintaining trapping structure throughout.
Counter-fighting with trapping. Your defensive game should be formidable now.
Final day - pure trapping focus. Repeat until the movements are unconscious. You've completed the intensive!
